rule.trigger: pair (Up on one venue + Down on the other) costs more than 4c under $1 after both taker fees, on the 250 ms grid, min(Lighter size, PM hedge size) >= 5
rule.lighter_leg: matches 500 ms after the trigger at the trigger price or better, >= 5 shown
rule.pm_hedge: 500 ms after the Lighter match at the prevailing PM price
rule.clip: min(Lighter displayed, PM displayed), capped at 200 shares
rule.fees: Lighter 0.01 p(1-p); Polymarket per window as in force (Gamma feeSchedule rate of that market)

holdout: BTC and ETH 15m windows starting on or after 2026-11-13 00:00 UTC, through the last complete day (2026-11-23)
pass_all: 90% range of $/day (resampling windows) above 0 on both BTC and ETH at 500+500 ms
point estimate positive on both at 1 s + 1 s
not mostly from the last 2 minutes (late share of $ < 0.5)
